statement: theorem iterate_complete_of_step_attained (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (T : ℕ) (hatt : ∀ t < T, ∀ x, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x → ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + (((η t)⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p) : ∃ p, iterate V ψ η loss x0 T = some p
